subject: MCFA without robust fit statistics: why?

messages.author: e8f36062fb2b90c1
messages.subject: MCFA without robust fit statistics: why?
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am running a MCFA using saturated between-level model and would like to use the MLR estimator due to missing data and violations of normality. My model consists of a total of five factors and three of them only have two indicators. I don’t obtain robust fit statistics (robust chi-square, robust CFI, robust TLI, robust RMSEA) when using MLR. I am not sure why this is happening.

  1. Are the missing values due to the empirical underidentification of two factors? Why am I getting fit statistics for ML?
  2. What can be done to get the robust fit statistics?
  3.  I am only interested in the level 1 model and want to get the loadings for the indicators and fit statistics on that level. Is a possible alternative to calculate a normal cfa with only group-mean-centered indicators?
  4. What could be reasons that standard errors are high for some indicators?

If anyone has any ideas that would be very much appreciated. My code and results are below.

twolevel <- '

level: 1

per.attr =~ attr_pers_1 + attr_pers_2 + attr_interes_1

relat.attr =~ attr_tklima_1 + attr_tklima_2 + attr_wett_1

aufga.attr =~ attr_indep_1 + attr_indep_2

strk.attr =~ attr_strk_1 + attr_strk_2 

status.attr =~ attr_status_2 + attr_status_1

attr_pers_1 ~~ attr_pers_1 + attr_pers_2 + attr_interes_1 + attr_tklima_1 + attr_tklima_2 + attr_wett_1 + attr_indep_1 + attr_indep_2 + attr_strk_1 + attr_strk_2 + attr_status_1 + attr_status_2
